pub fn float_sub() {
    let mut criterion = Criterion::default().configure_from_args();

    sub_f32(&mut criterion);
    sub_f64(&mut criterion);

    #[cfg(f128_enabled)]
    {
        sub_f128(&mut criterion);
    }
}
